description:
Functional specifications/files: strengthen current uncommitted executor credential HTTP tests with exact structured credential errors, selective persisted Oban mutation-job processing, and explicit warm-server authentication stability before/after delivery. Add a supervised test-only request capture helper only if mailbox capture cannot provide deterministic barriers.
Tests first: persisted grant changes without notification retain old key on same PID; selected job delivery completes then new PID/key; exact personal-required/global-missing/revoked/expired reasons; no unrelated jobs drained.
Branches: warm reuse, targeted job selection, absent/revoked/expired errors, provider 401 retries.
Mocking: OpenAIStub only at external LLM edge; all ZAQ operations real.
Docs: test names only unless contract drift is found.
Action reuse: not applicable — test-only orchestration reuses existing Connect, Oban, NodeRouter, Executor and ServerManager operations.
title: [zaq-jrg.43] Harden credential HTTP test synchronization and mutation selection
